evidence_status_definitions.DISCOVERY_ONLY: Not independently validated for predictive use.
evidence_status_definitions.FAMILY_FDR: Holdout direction + non-overlap confirmation + actor-family BH-FDR <=10%.
evidence_status_definitions.GLOBAL_FDR: Holdout direction + non-overlap confirmation + global BH-FDR <=10%.
evidence_status_definitions.HOLDOUT_DIRECTION_CONFIRMED: Discovery direction replicated in chronological holdout; dependence gate not passed.
evidence_status_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_N: Independent sample below 15 for continuous evidence.
evidence_status_definitions.NONOVERLAP_CONFIRMED: Holdout direction retained in independent episodes but not FDR significant.

pp_definition: percentage points relative to unconditional holdout return; not an absolute price forecast
promotion_gate: Retrospective evidence cannot change production weights; prospective immutable live evidence remains a separate gate.
threshold_inference: circular moving-block bootstrap + non-overlapping confirmation + family/global BH-FDR
